column2: When starting, the app says “The database is being used by another program”: what should I do?
column3: Another program is holding your family tree’s file: another copy of the app, software that has opened it, or a sync (OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud…) copying it right now. The app says so after a few seconds and changes nothing. Close that other program or wait for the sync to finish, then restart the app. If it happens at every start, restart the computer: the program that was holding the file will be closed.
